title: Alias vocabulary: index sub-tokens of [symbol] short names (split on '_')
description:
sutra_explore resolves [component] names and [symbol] SHORT names (the segment after the last '/', via short_name_of), but not sub-tokens. For a namespaced alias like `dashas/vimshottari_main`, "vimshottari_main" resolves (short name) but "vimshottari" does NOT — short_name_of() splits only on '/', never '_', and resolve() is exact-match. Users naturally search the bare technique term ("vimshottari", "shodashottari"), which is the domain term the alias file exists to resolve.

Fix (in src/vocabulary.rs::sync_aliases): in addition to the full term and the '/'-trailing short name, split the short name on '_' and emit each meaningful sub-token as an additional alias row pointing at the same target. `dashas/vimshottari_main` then indexes {dashas/vimshottari_main, vimshottari_main, vimshottari, main}.

Design notes:
- Reuses the existing exact-match resolve() path — no matching-semantics change.
- No schema migration: the `aliases` table is a pure projection rebuilt wholesale by replace_all_aliases on every sync; changes land on next sync_aliases (reset alias_sync marker to force reprojection).
- Short-name collisions already "return ALL matches" by design, so sub-token collisions across symbols are intended behavior.
- Apply a SHORT stoplist for generic segments (main, report, table, init, dispatch, handler, panel, 2nd, etc.) to avoid noisy resolvable terms. Josh approved a short stoplist.

Validates against kala-reverse's .sutra/aliases.toml: after the fix, `sutra_explore(vimshottari)` should resolve to FUN_005ec7a0.

acceptance_criteria.text: sync_aliases emits sub-token alias rows from '_'-split short names, same target
Existing full-term + short-name resolution still works (no regression)
Unit test covers sub-token projection + stoplist exclusion

Verified LIVE on kala-reverse after redeploy: explore('vimshottari') -> FUN_005ec7a0+FUN_005eeba0, explore('shodashottari') -> FUN_005d90d0, explore('main') leaks no dasha (stoplist holds). Migration 0066 reprojected on new-binary startup.

execution_record:
Implemented in src/vocabulary.rs: sub_tokens() splits a namespaced [symbol] term's short name (segment after last '/') on '_', dropping stoplisted generics and <3-char segments and collapsing dups; sync_aliases emits one extra projection row per sub-token (synthetic unique `term#subtoken` key, sub-token in short_name column, same target_kind/target_ref) so bare technique words resolve via the existing exact-match short-name path (resolve() Priority 1.5). Refactored the record closure into a free push_alias() + AliasTuple type alias (avoids clippy type_complexity / borrow conflict). No schema change — aliases is a pure rebuilt projection.

Surprise/catch during execution: a code-only projection change does NOT reproject, because sync_aliases_if_changed is gated on the aliases.toml content hash (unchanged). Added migration 0066 to null the alias_sync marker (mirrors 0062's approach for the schema change) so the next startup re-projects under the new logic.

Verified: cargo test --lib vocabulary (10 pass) + --test vocabulary_test (19 pass, incl. new test_resolve_subtoken_of_short_name asserting vimshottari resolves and 'main' does not); cargo clippy --lib clean for vocabulary.rs (6 pre-existing warnings in other files only). Two commits on sutra main.

PENDING (not landed to the live tool): the running sutra MCP server in Josh's sessions is the old binary; live sutra_explore('vimshottari') on kala-reverse won't resolve until sutra is rebuilt/installed and the MCP server restarts (migration 0066 then reprojects automatically on that first startup). This is an operational deploy step in Josh's control; flagged to Josh rather than a separate task.
